cards.title: Lavender cologne
cards.evidence_summary: Existing fresh-lavender reference descriptions plus exact citrus-flower products motivate a cologne hypothesis.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Use citrus-flower lift around the lavender recognizer before investigating heavier support; a cologne structure does not require an amberwood chassis.
function_map: Lavender: protected recognizer only when required by the brief.
Neroli-type flower and petitgrain-type leaf: separate transition hypotheses.
Drydown support: compare a restrained version with the control.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Lavender cologne control.
comparison.change: Compare one neroli or petitgrain bridge at a time, without changing the lavender block.
comparison.question: Does the citrus-flower bridge preserve lavender beyond the initial freshness?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Official perfume notes are architecture only, not a formula or evidence of Ambrox absence.
Neroli and petitgrain are not stock substitutes.

cards.title: Green barbershop lavender
cards.evidence_summary: Official aromatic references support distinguishing herbal-green fougere texture from mineral amberwood effects.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Test an herbal-green bridge and dry mossy impression around a legible lavender core; keep sweetness an independent axis.

comparison.change: Omit the herbal bridge while keeping other blocks fixed.
comparison.question: Does the herbal facet add a barbershop recognizer or merely medicinal sharpness?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Modern commercial descriptions do not reveal historical or proprietary formula quantities.

cards.title: Vanillic-resin lavender
cards.evidence_summary: Lavender-vanilla commercial architecture and a named balsamic benzoin grade support a softer route than mineral amberwoods.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Separate rounded vanillic warmth from resin body, then ask whether either improves the lavender transition.
function_map: Benzoin-type balsamic body: optional second dimension, not automatically needed.

comparison.control: Unchanged target or simplest recognisable Vanillic-resin lavender control.
comparison.change: Compare the minimal lavender-vanillic control against a resin-bridge alternative.

comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Siam benzoin is not interchangeable with Sumatra benzoin or a generic amber base.

cards.title: Soft musky lavender
cards.evidence_summary: Official lavender-musky architecture and distinct musk descriptions support testing texture independently of woody-amber power.
cards.construction_hypothesis: Compare a restrained soft-musk cushion with a fruit-associated musk bridge; do not maximise musk or assume the two are redundant.

comparison.change: Run a soft-musk versus fruity-musk alternative while preserving the target block.
comparison.question: Does the musk retain lavender identity or leave an unrelated clean drydown?
comparison.stop: Reject the alternative if the locked recognizer weakens, an avoid constraint becomes noticeable, or the result cannot be distinguished reliably.

identity_limits: Manufacturer tenacity language is not delivered concentration or perfume longevity.
A referenced perfume is not certified Ambrox-free.
